name: farmart-dev
description: Farmart development agent with safety guardrails

preToolUse.command: node -e "const chunks=[]; process.stdin.on('data',d=>chunks.push(d)); process.stdin.on('end',()=>{ const e=JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString()); const cmd=(e.tool_input&&e.tool_input.command)||''; if(/rm\s+-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|rm\s+-[a-zA-Z]*f[a-zA-Z]*r/.test(cmd)){ process.stderr.write('BLOCKED: rm -rf is not allowed. Use a safer delete command.'); process.exit(2); } process.exit(0); })"
